entities.summary: Neira Ortiz Ruiz is a Puerto Rican professional volleyball player. She has represented Puerto Rico as a member of the Puerto Rico women's national volleyball team. With a height of 6 feet and 5 inches, Ortiz is an outside hitter from the right-side position in her sport.
